title: Character Spacing (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Character Spacing applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Character Spacing (BtnCharacterSpacing) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Character Spacing documents the toggle-gallery-only contract (REG-TEXTFONTPROPS-001 disposition b)
scenarios.expected: Production catalog and context menu carry the corrected contract: Character Spacing exposes exactly one catalog variant 'More Spacing...' and Strikethrough exactly one 'Toggle Strikethrough Formatting'; the Feature Explorer discovery help no longer advertises the dead explicit-action paths (no 'Right-click to apply Very Tight', no 'Apply/Remove Strikethrough Formatting'); each context-menu block dispatches only the working native route (CharacterSpacingFeature.ExecuteMoreSpacing, FormatStrikethroughFeature.Execute) and resurrecting a dead explicit-action route (CharacterSpacingFeature.ExecuteSpecific, FormatStrikethroughFeature.Apply/Remove) fails the pin.
